name: Tenant estoppel certificate
what: A tenant's signed statement of its lease terms, rent paid and any defaults, which a buyer or lender can rely on.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.definition: The tenant that signed the certificate, and the name and title of the person who signed for it.

fields.label: Certificate date
fields.definition: The date the tenant signed; the statements speak as of this date, so compare it with the closing date and any date the contract or lender requires.

fields.label: Who may rely
fields.definition: The buyer, lender and others the certificate names as entitled to rely on it, including any assignees.

fields.label: Lease documents listed
fields.definition: The lease, amendments and side letters the tenant certifies are the whole agreement; any document in the file that is missing from this list is a difference.

fields.label: Premises and area
fields.definition: The suite and square feet the tenant certifies it leases.

fields.label: Term dates
fields.definition: The commencement and expiration dates the tenant certifies for the current term.

fields.label: Current monthly base rent
fields.definition: The base rent the tenant certifies it pays now, and any recovery estimate it states.

fields.label: Rent paid through
fields.definition: The date through which the tenant certifies rent is paid.

fields.label: Rent paid in advance
fields.definition: Rent paid more than one period ahead, as the tenant states it; zero when the certificate says none.

fields.label: Security deposit
fields.definition: The deposit or letter of credit the tenant certifies the landlord holds.

fields.label: Defaults claimed
fields.definition: Any default by the landlord or the tenant, and any offset, credit or defense against rent the tenant claims; record the words used, including knowledge qualifiers.

fields.label: Landlord obligations open
fields.definition: Improvement work, allowances, free rent or other landlord obligations the tenant says are still unpaid or unfinished.

fields.label: Options and rights
fields.definition: The renewal, expansion, termination, purchase and first refusal rights the tenant certifies it holds.

fields.label: Differences from the lease and rent roll
fields.definition: The analyst's list of every statement that does not match the lease file or the rent roll, with both versions side by side.
